I'm sorry you're going through that. Training is a good place to put that energy, and I can help there — but let's keep it to the gym side, not the rest of it.

If you want, I can set you up with a solid block to sink your teeth into — tell me what you're after (strength, a running goal, general fitness) and how many days a week you can commit, and I'll build it. Keeping busy with real sessions, real numbers, something to chase — that part I can absolutely do.
